description: This file implements the SocketPort class, which manages socket operations including creation, configuration, connection, listening, accepting, reading, writing, and multicast group management. It includes platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems, and handles socket initialization, buffer management, event handling, and error processing within a network communication context.

classes.name: WinSocketInitializer
classes.description: Handles Windows-specific socket initialization, including WSAStartup and WSARecvMsg function pointer setup.

methods.name: ReceiveFrom
methods.description: Receives data from a socket, with platform-specific handling for Windows and POSIX, including extraction of interface index information from ancillary data.

methods.name: DestroySocket
methods.description: Closes and invalidates a socket handle, platform-specific.

methods.name: SetNonBlocking
methods.description: Sets a socket to non-blocking mode, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: ConstructSocket
methods.description: Creates and configures a socket based on local node info and optional specific interface, handling platform-specific socket options and binding.

methods.name: BufferAlignment
methods.description: Adjusts socket buffer sizes and allocates internal buffers accordingly.

methods.name: WaitForOpen
methods.description: Waits for a socket to become open within a specified timeout.

methods.name: WaitForWriteComplete
methods.description: Waits for ongoing write operations to complete within a specified timeout.

methods.name: WaitForClosure
methods.description: Waits for socket closure within a specified timeout.

methods.name: Events
methods.description: Determines the current socket event flags based on socket state and errors.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles socket events, calling appropriate methods based on event flags.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket into internal buffer, handling errors and partial reads.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Sends data from internal buffer over the socket, handling partial sends and errors.

methods.name: Closed
methods.description: Closes the socket and cleans up resources.

methods.name: Opened
methods.description: Marks the socket as open and updates state.

methods.name: Accepted
methods.description: Handles acceptance of incoming connection.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection, returning a new socket handle.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection and updates internal socket handle.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Sets up the socket to listen for incoming connections.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Joins a multicast group.

methods.name: Leave
methods.description: Leaves a multicast group.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Joins a multicast source group.

methods.name: Leave
methods.description: Leaves a multicast source group.
